title: Jubilee
summary: Jubilee proclaimed release, return, and restoration, reminding Israel that the land and people belonged to the Lord.
background: The fiftieth year involved liberty, restoration of property, and release from certain forms of bondage. It declared that Israel lived under God’s ownership.
teachingHelp: Connect Jubilee to release, restoration, and the Lord’s ownership, while being careful not to overstate details beyond the text.
